title: Time Stone Moon Porcelain Tile
old:
Time Stone Moon porcelain tile, sold per sqm to the nearest full box.

  • Available in 300x600mm and 600x600mm
  • Matt or Lappato finish
  • Material: Porcelain
  • Slip rating: P4/R11
  • Suitable for dry and wet area applications
  • Box coverage: 1.44m²
  • Recommended grout: Ardex Misty Grey 341
new:
Time Stone Moon is a pale grey stone-look porcelain with soft, cloudy movement and faint veining, so it reads as a light neutral rather than a busy pattern. The matt version carries a P4/R11 slip rating, which makes it one of the few light tiles here you can run straight from the living room into the bathroom floor.

Use it for

  • Open-plan floors, bathrooms and laundries in the matt finish
  • Feature walls and dry floors in the lappato (semi-polished) finish
  • Lightening a room that does not get much natural light

Specifications

  • Material: glazed porcelain
  • Sizes: 298 x 600 mm and 600 x 600 mm
  • Finish: matt or lappato
  • Thickness: 9.5 mm
  • Slip rating: P4/R11 (matt)
  • Box coverage: 1.44 m²
  • Sold per square metre and supplied to the nearest full box.

Good to know

  • P4 slip rating: suits bathroom and laundry floors and covered outdoor areas such as an alfresco.
  • The lappato finish has no slip rating, so use it on walls and dry floors only.
  • Back-butter the 600 x 600 mm tiles on a flat, primed floor so the adhesive covers the whole back.
  • Recommended grout: Ardex Misty Grey 341.
notes: Supplier page confirms sizes and finishes. P4/R11, box coverage and grout kept from old description.
